title: Opapru honors Army, PNP for supporting peacebuilding in BARMM
summary: COTABATO CITY — The Office of the Presidential Adviser on Peace, Reconciliation, and Unity (Opapru) honored military and police officials in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao…

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — The Office of the Presidential Adviser on Peace, Reconciliation, and Unity (Opapru) honored military and police officials in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) for their contribution and strong partnership in advancing the government’s peacebuilding efforts in the region. Presidential Peace Adviser Mel Senen Sarmiento personally awarded the recognition to Maj. Gen. Edgar L. Catu, commander of the Army’s 6th Infantry Division and Joint Task Force Central, and Brig. Gen. Christopher M. Abecia, regional director of Police Regional Office-Bangsamoro Autonomous Region (PRO-BAR), during ceremonies held at Camp Siongco in Datu Odin Sinsuat, Maguindanao del Norte, on […]...
